request: The admin endpoint's host allow-list check must compare hosts case-insensitively: an allowed origin and a request Host that differ only in letter case must be accepted.

defects.description: Published bug fixed upstream: admin: fix host allow-list comparison to be case-insensitive (#7993)

trigger.input:
printf %s '' | base64 -d > admin_checkhost_case_test.go
if go test -count=1 -run '^(TestAdminHandlerCheckHostCaseInsensitive)$' . >/dev/null 2>&1; then echo probe: pass; else echo probe: fail; fi

defects.why_missed: The project's own suite at the parent commit never exercised this input; the fix commit added the test that does.
